#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

// 3D index calculation
inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {
    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;
}

// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions
double computeLaplacian(const std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
                        const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {
    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;
    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;
    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;
    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;
    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;
    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;
    
    const double cxx = (c[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)] - 
                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dx * dx);
    const double cyy = (c[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)] - 
                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dy * dy);
    const double czz = (c[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, ny)] - 
                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dz * dz);
    
    return cxx + cyy + czz;
}

// Compute chemical potential
void computeChemicalPotential(const std::vector<double>& c, std::vector<double>& mu,
                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,
                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                const double cv = c[idx];
                
                mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) 
                         + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv
                         - gamma * computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Cahn-Hilliard update step
void cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,
                        const std::vector<double>& mu,
                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + dt * D * 
                           computeLaplacian(mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Initialize concentration field
void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;
    
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                // Generate pseudo-random value in [-1, 1]
                const size_t linear_id = z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;
                const double pseudo = ((((linear_id + 1) * 1299709) % vol) / static_cast<double>(vol));
                c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
            }
        }
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {
    // Check for NaN or Inf
    for (const auto& val : c) {
        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {
            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field
    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded
    double minVal = c[0];
    double maxVal = c[0];
    for (const auto& val : c) {
        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);
        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
    }
    
    printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minVal, maxVal);
    
    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds
    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {
        printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
        return false;
    }
    
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\n");
    printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    printf("  -i <num>     Number of time steps (default: 20)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t nx = 64;
    size_t ny = 0;
    size_t nz = 0;
    int iterations = 20;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-x") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-y") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-z") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;
    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;
    
    printf("Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\n");
    printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
    printf("Time steps: %d\n", iterations);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    // Physical parameters
    const double dx = 1.0;
    const double dy = 1.0;
    const double dz = 1.0;
    const double dt = 0.01;
    const double e_AA = -(2.0 / 9.0);
    const double e_BB = -(2.0 / 9.0);
    const double e_AB = (2.0 / 9.0);
    const double gamma = 0.5;
    const double D = 1.0;
    
    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;
    
    // Allocate arrays
    std::vector<double> cold(gridSize);
    std::vector<double> cnew(gridSize);
    std::vector<double> mu(gridSize);
    
    // Initialize concentration field
    printf("Initializing concentration field...\n");
    initializeConcentration(cold, nx, ny, nz);
    
    // Run simulation
    printf("Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\n");
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    for (int t = 0; t < iterations; ++t) {
        // Compute chemical potential
        computeChemicalPotential(cold, mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, 
                                gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);
        
        // Update concentration
        cahnHilliardUpdate(cnew, cold, mu, nx, ny, nz, D, dt, dx, dy, dz);
        
        // Swap buffers
        std::swap(cold, cnew);
    }
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
    
    // Calculate performance
    double cellUpdates = (double)gridSize * iterations;
    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;
    printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        print_results(cold, "Concentration");
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating result...\n");
        bool valid = validateResult(cold, nx, ny, nz);
        
        if (valid) {
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};

// 3D index calculation
inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {
    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;
}

// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions
double computeLaplacian(const std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
                        const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {
    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;
    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;
    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;
    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;
    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;
    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;
    
    const double cxx = (c[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)] - 
                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dx * dx);
    const double cyy = (c[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)] - 
                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dy * dy);
    const double czz = (c[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, ny)] - 
                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dz * dz);
    
    return cxx + cyy + czz;
}

// Compute chemical potential
void computeChemicalPotential(const std::vector<double>& c, std::vector<double>& mu,
                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,
                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                const double cv = c[idx];
                
                mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) 
                         + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv
                         - gamma * computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Cahn-Hilliard update step
void cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,
                        const std::vector<double>& mu,
                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + dt * D * 
                           computeLaplacian(mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Initialize concentration field
void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;
    
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                // Generate pseudo-random value in [-1, 1]
                const size_t linear_id = z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;
                const double pseudo = ((((linear_id + 1) * 1299709) % vol) / static_cast<double>(vol));
                c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
            }
        }
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {
    // Check for NaN or Inf
    for (const auto& val : c) {
        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {
            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field
    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded
    double minVal = c[0];
    double maxVal = c[0];
    for (const auto& val : c) {
        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);
        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
    }
    
    printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minVal, maxVal);
    
    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds
    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {
        printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
        return false;
    }
    
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\n");
    printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    printf("  -i <num>     Number of time steps (default: 20)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

codex
I’m implementing a fused CUDA timestep rather than merely porting the two CPU loops. Each CUDA block streams a coalesced \(32\times8\) tile through eight Z planes, keeps concentration and chemical-potential halos in shared memory, and writes only the next concentration field. This removes the full-grid `mu` allocation and its global-memory round trip while preserving the two-stage stencil dependency within every timestep. CUDA Graph replay will reduce launch overhead across repeated steps.

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
+    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
+    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
+    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
+    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
+    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
+    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
+    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {
+            const int haloX = muX + kBlockX;
+            potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + haloX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+                below, center, above, haloX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
         }
     }
 }

-            }
+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
         }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration) {
+    const size_t volume = concentration.size();
+    for (size_t linearId = 0; linearId < volume; ++linearId) {
+        const double pseudo =
+            ((linearId + 1) * size_t{1299709} % volume) /
+            static_cast<double>(volume);
+        concentration[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
     }
 }

+bool parsePositiveSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {

+    char* end = nullptr;

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,

+constexpr int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr int kBlockY = 8;
+constexpr int kThreadsPerBlock = kBlockX * kBlockY;
+constexpr int kZPerBlock = 8;

+// A concentration tile has a two-cell X/Y halo.  This is enough to compute a
+// one-cell-halo tile of chemical potentials, which in turn supplies the halo
+// needed by the Cahn-Hilliard update.
+constexpr int kCTileX = kBlockX + 4;
+constexpr int kCTileY = kBlockY + 4;
+constexpr int kCPlaneSize = kCTileX * kCTileY;
+constexpr int kMuTileX = kBlockX + 2;
+constexpr int kMuTileY = kBlockY + 2;
+constexpr int kMuPlaneSize = kMuTileX * kMuTileY;

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* operation, const cudaError_t error) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+void cudaCheck(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+        cudaFailure(operation, error);
+    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                   const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ int ringSlot(const int head, const int offset,
+                                        const int ringSize) {
+    const int slot = head + offset;
+    return slot < ringSize ? slot : slot - ringSize;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationValue(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const int tileX, const int tileY, const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    // Each warp loads one row at a time.  The first 32 columns are fully
+    // coalesced; four lanes then load the right edge of the halo.
+    for (int tileY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); tileY < kCTileY;
+         tileY += kBlockY) {
+        const int tileX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        loadConcentrationValue(concentration, tile, tileX, tileY, rawZ, baseX,
+                               baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);

+            loadConcentrationValue(concentration, tile, tileX + kBlockX,
+                                   tileY, rawZ, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                                   planeStride);
         }
     }

-void cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,
-                        const std::vector<double>& mu,
-                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
+    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
+    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
+    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
+    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
+    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
+    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
+    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {
+            const int haloX = muX + kBlockX;
+            potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + haloX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+                below, center, above, haloX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
         }
     }
 }

-void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {

-                c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;

+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
         }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}
+

+        concentration[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
     }
 }

+bool parsePositiveSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                   size_t& planeStride, size_t& volume) {
+    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    planeStride = nx * ny;
+    if (planeStride > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    volume = planeStride * nz;
+    return volume <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double);
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
+    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
+    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
+    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
+    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
+    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
+    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
+    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {
+            const int haloX = muX + kBlockX;
+            potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + haloX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+                below, center, above, haloX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
         }
     }
 }

-void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {

+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
         }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}

+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration) {
+    const size_t volume = concentration.size();
+    for (size_t linearId = 0; linearId < volume; ++linearId) {
+        const double pseudo =
+            ((linearId + 1) * size_t{1299709} % volume) /
+            static_cast<double>(volume);
+        concentration[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
     }
 }

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                   size_t& planeStride, size_t& volume) {
+    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    planeStride = nx * ny;
+    if (planeStride > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    volume = planeStride * nz;
+    return volume <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double);
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                   const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
+    }

+    const int slot = head + offset;

+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    // Each warp loads one row at a time.  The first 32 columns are fully
+    // coalesced; four lanes then load the right edge of the halo.

-void cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
+    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
+    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
+    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
+    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
+    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
+    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
+    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {
+            const int haloX = muX + kBlockX;
+            potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + haloX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+                below, center, above, haloX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
         }
     }
 }

+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
         }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}

+bool parsePositiveSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                   size_t& planeStride, size_t& volume) {
+    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    planeStride = nx * ny;
+    if (planeStride > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    volume = planeStride * nz;
+    return volume <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double);

+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,

-                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
+    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
+    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
+    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
+    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
+    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
+    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
+    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {
+            const int haloX = muX + kBlockX;
+            potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + haloX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+                below, center, above, haloX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
         }
     }

+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
         }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration) {

+        const double pseudo =
+            ((linearId + 1) * size_t{1299709} % volume) /
+            static_cast<double>(volume);
+        concentration[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
     }
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,

-void cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
+    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
+    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
+    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
+    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
+    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
+    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
+    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {
+            const int haloX = muX + kBlockX;
+            potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + haloX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+                below, center, above, haloX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
         }
     }
 }

+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
         }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                   size_t& planeStride, size_t& volume) {
