+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}

+template <bool ComputePotential>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 4) void streamedStencil(
+    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
+    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
+    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double tile[kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long z = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const size_t rawX = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+    const size_t rawY = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+    const size_t x = rawX < nx ? rawX : nx - 1;
+    const size_t y = rawY < ny ? rawY : ny - 1;
+
+    size_t centerIndex = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    double below = stencilInput[(z == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<size_t>(z) - 1) *
+                                    planeStride +
+                                y * nx + x];
+    double center = stencilInput[centerIndex];
+    double above = stencilInput[(static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1 < nz
+                                     ? static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1
+                                     : static_cast<size_t>(z)) *
+                                    planeStride +
+                                y * nx + x];
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (z >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1] = center;
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            const size_t haloX = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
+            tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx +
+                             haloX];
+        } else if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+            const size_t haloX = x + 1 < nx ? x + 1 : x;
+            tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX + kBlockX + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx +
+                             haloX];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            const size_t haloY = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
+            tile[tx + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride +
+                             haloY * nx + x];
+        } else if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+            const size_t haloY = y + 1 < ny ? y + 1 : y;
+            tile[(kBlockY + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride +
+                             haloY * nx + x];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (rawX < nx && rawY < ny) {
+            const int sharedIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double cxx = tile[sharedIndex + 1] +
+                               tile[sharedIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+            const double cyy = tile[sharedIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                               tile[sharedIndex - kMuTileX] - 2.0 * center;
+            const double czz = above + below - 2.0 * center;
+            const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+            if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
+                output[centerIndex] = center * center * center - center -
+                                      0.5 * laplacian;
+            } else {
+                output[centerIndex] =
+                    oldConcentration[centerIndex] + 0.01 * laplacian;
             }
         }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock || z + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        ++z;
+        centerIndex += planeStride;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        const size_t nextZ = static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1 < nz
+                                 ? static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1
+                                 : static_cast<size_t>(z);
+        above = stencilInput[nextZ * planeStride + y * nx + x];
     }
 }

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                   size_t& planeStride, size_t& volume) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                   const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ int ringSlot(const int head, const int offset,
+                                        const int ringSize) {
+    const int slot = head + offset;
+    return slot < ringSize ? slot : slot - ringSize;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationValue(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const int tileX, const int tileY, const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + tileX - 2;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + tileY - 2;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawZ, nz);
+    tile[tileY * kCTileX + tileX] =
+        concentration[z * planeStride + y * nx + x];
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    // Each warp loads one row at a time.  The first 32 columns are fully
+    // coalesced; four lanes then load the right edge of the halo.
+    for (int tileY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); tileY < kCTileY;
+         tileY += kBlockY) {
+        const int tileX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        loadConcentrationValue(concentration, tile, tileX, tileY, rawZ, baseX,
+                               baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        if (tileX < kCTileX - kBlockX) {
+            loadConcentrationValue(concentration, tile, tileX + kBlockX,
+                                   tileY, rawZ, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                                   planeStride);
         }
     }
 }
 
-// Cahn-Hilliard update step
-void cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,
-                        const std::vector<double>& mu,
-                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
-                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {
-    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
-        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
-            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
+    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
+    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
+    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
+    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
+    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
+    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
+    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {

+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}

+template <bool ComputePotential>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 4) void streamedStencil(
+    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
+    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
+    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double tile[kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long z = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const size_t rawX = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+    const size_t rawY = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+    const size_t x = rawX < nx ? rawX : nx - 1;
+    const size_t y = rawY < ny ? rawY : ny - 1;
+
+    size_t centerIndex = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    double below = stencilInput[(z == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<size_t>(z) - 1) *
+                                    planeStride +
+                                y * nx + x];
+    double center = stencilInput[centerIndex];
+    double above = stencilInput[(static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1 < nz
+                                     ? static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1
+                                     : static_cast<size_t>(z)) *
+                                    planeStride +
+                                y * nx + x];
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (z >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1] = center;
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            const size_t haloX = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
+            tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx +
+                             haloX];
+        } else if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+            const size_t haloX = x + 1 < nx ? x + 1 : x;
+            tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX + kBlockX + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx +
+                             haloX];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            const size_t haloY = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
+            tile[tx + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride +
+                             haloY * nx + x];
+        } else if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+            const size_t haloY = y + 1 < ny ? y + 1 : y;
+            tile[(kBlockY + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride +
+                             haloY * nx + x];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (rawX < nx && rawY < ny) {
+            const int sharedIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double cxx = tile[sharedIndex + 1] +
+                               tile[sharedIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+            const double cyy = tile[sharedIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                               tile[sharedIndex - kMuTileX] - 2.0 * center;
+            const double czz = above + below - 2.0 * center;
+            const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+            if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
+                output[centerIndex] = center * center * center - center -
+                                      0.5 * laplacian;
+            } else {
+                output[centerIndex] =
+                    oldConcentration[centerIndex] + 0.01 * laplacian;
             }
         }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock || z + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        ++z;
+        centerIndex += planeStride;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        const size_t nextZ = static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1 < nz
+                                 ? static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1
+                                 : static_cast<size_t>(z);
+        above = stencilInput[nextZ * planeStride + y * nx + x];
     }
 }

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

namespace {

constexpr int kBlockX = 32;
constexpr int kBlockY = 2;
constexpr int kThreadsPerBlock = kBlockX * kBlockY;
constexpr int kZPerBlock = 8;

// A concentration tile has a two-cell X/Y halo.  This is enough to compute a
// one-cell-halo tile of chemical potentials, which in turn supplies the halo
// needed by the Cahn-Hilliard update.
constexpr int kCTileX = kBlockX + 4;
constexpr int kCTileY = kBlockY + 4;
constexpr int kCPlaneSize = kCTileX * kCTileY;
constexpr int kMuTileX = kBlockX + 2;
constexpr int kMuTileY = kBlockY + 2;
constexpr int kMuPlaneSize = kMuTileX * kMuTileY;

[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* operation, const cudaError_t error) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation, cudaGetErrorString(error));
    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void cudaCheck(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
    if (error != cudaSuccess) {
        cudaFailure(operation, error);
    }
}

__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
                                                   const size_t extent) {
    if (coordinate <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;
}

__device__ __forceinline__ int ringSlot(const int head, const int offset,
                                        const int ringSize) {
    const int slot = head + offset;
    return slot < ringSize ? slot : slot - ringSize;
}

__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationValue(
    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
    const int tileX, const int tileY, const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX,
    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
    const size_t planeStride) {
    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + tileX - 2;
    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + tileY - 2;
    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawZ, nz);
    tile[tileY * kCTileX + tileX] =
        concentration[z * planeStride + y * nx + x];
}

__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(
    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
    const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY,
    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
    const size_t planeStride) {
    // Each warp loads one row at a time.  The first 32 columns are fully
    // coalesced; four lanes then load the right edge of the halo.
    for (int tileY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); tileY < kCTileY;
         tileY += kBlockY) {
        const int tileX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
        loadConcentrationValue(concentration, tile, tileX, tileY, rawZ, baseX,
                               baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
        if (tileX < kCTileX - kBlockX) {
            loadConcentrationValue(concentration, tile, tileX + kBlockX,
                                   tileY, rawZ, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
                                   planeStride);
        }
    }
}

__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
    const double value = center[centerIndex];

    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
    }
}

void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration) {
    const size_t volume = concentration.size();
    for (size_t linearId = 0; linearId < volume; ++linearId) {
        const double pseudo =
            ((linearId + 1) * size_t{1299709} % volume) /
            static_cast<double>(volume);
        concentration[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& concentration) {
    for (const double value : concentration) {
        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }

    const auto [minimum, maximum] =
        std::minmax_element(concentration.begin(), concentration.end());
    std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", *minimum, *maximum);
    if (*maximum > 10.0 || *minimum < -10.0) {
        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool parsePositiveSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
    errno = 0;
    char* end = nullptr;
    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
        return false;
    }
    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
    return true;
}

bool parseNonnegativeInt(const char* text, int& value) {
    errno = 0;
    char* end = nullptr;
    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 ||
        parsed > std::numeric_limits<int>::max()) {
        return false;
    }
    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* programName) {
    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);
    std::printf("Options:\n");
    std::printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\n");
    std::printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    std::printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of time steps (default: 20)\n");
    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
                   size_t& planeStride, size_t& volume) {
    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
        return false;
    }
    planeStride = nx * ny;
    if (planeStride > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
        return false;
    }
    volume = planeStride * nz;
    return volume <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double);
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t nx = 64;
    size_t ny = 0;
    size_t nz = 0;
    int iterations = 20;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;

    for (int argument = 1; argument < argc; ++argument) {
        if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-x") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
            if (!parsePositiveSize(argv[++argument], nx)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Invalid X grid size\n");
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-y") == 0 &&
                   argument + 1 < argc) {
            if (!parsePositiveSize(argv[++argument], ny)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Invalid Y grid size\n");
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-z") == 0 &&
                   argument + 1 < argc) {
            if (!parsePositiveSize(argv[++argument], nz)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Invalid Z grid size\n");
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-i") == 0 &&
                   argument + 1 < argc) {
            if (!parseNonnegativeInt(argv[++argument], iterations)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Invalid number of time steps\n");
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return EXIT_SUCCESS;
        } else {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Unknown option: %s\n", argv[argument]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
    }

    if (ny == 0) {
        ny = nx;
    }
    if (nz == 0) {
        nz = nx;
    }

    size_t planeStride = 0;
    size_t gridSize = 0;
    if (!checkedVolume(nx, ny, nz, planeStride, gridSize) ||
        nx > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<long long>::max()) ||
        ny > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<long long>::max()) ||
        nz > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<long long>::max())) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid dimensions are too large\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    std::printf("Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\n");
    std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
    std::printf("Time steps: %d\n", iterations);
    std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");

    int device = 0;
    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
    cudaCheck(cudaGetDevice(&device), "selecting the CUDA device");
    cudaCheck(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device),
              "querying the CUDA device");

    const size_t blocksX = (nx + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX;
    const size_t blocksY = (ny + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY;
    const size_t blocksZ = (nz + kZPerBlock - 1) / kZPerBlock;
    if (blocksX > static_cast<size_t>(properties.maxGridSize[0]) ||
        blocksY > static_cast<size_t>(properties.maxGridSize[1]) ||
        blocksZ > static_cast<size_t>(properties.maxGridSize[2])) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid exceeds CUDA launch-dimension limits\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    std::printf("CUDA device: %s\n", properties.name);

    std::vector<double> concentration(gridSize);
    std::printf("Initializing concentration field...\n");
    initializeConcentration(concentration);

    double* deviceCurrent = nullptr;
    double* deviceNext = nullptr;
    double* devicePotential = nullptr;
    const size_t bytes = gridSize * sizeof(double);
    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&deviceCurrent, bytes), "allocating the current field");
    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&deviceNext, bytes), "allocating the next field");
    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&devicePotential, bytes),
              "allocating the chemical-potential field");
    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(deviceCurrent, concentration.data(), bytes,
                         cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
              "copying the initial field to the GPU");
    cudaCheck(cudaFuncSetCacheConfig(directStencil<true>, cudaFuncCachePreferL1),
              "configuring the CUDA stencil kernel");
    cudaCheck(cudaFuncSetCacheConfig(directStencil<false>, cudaFuncCachePreferL1),
              "configuring the CUDA update kernel");

    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
    cudaCheck(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking),
              "creating the CUDA stream");

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                   const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ int ringSlot(const int head, const int offset,
+                                        const int ringSize) {
+    const int slot = head + offset;
+    return slot < ringSize ? slot : slot - ringSize;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationValue(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const int tileX, const int tileY, const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + tileX - 2;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + tileY - 2;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawZ, nz);
+    tile[tileY * kCTileX + tileX] =
+        concentration[z * planeStride + y * nx + x];
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentration, double* __restrict__ tile,
+    const long long rawZ, const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    // Each warp loads one row at a time.  The first 32 columns are fully
+    // coalesced; four lanes then load the right edge of the halo.
+    for (int tileY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); tileY < kCTileY;
+         tileY += kBlockY) {
+        const int tileX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        loadConcentrationValue(concentration, tile, tileX, tileY, rawZ, baseX,
+                               baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        if (tileX < kCTileX - kBlockX) {
+            loadConcentrationValue(concentration, tile, tileX + kBlockX,
+                                   tileY, rawZ, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                                   planeStride);
         }
     }
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotentialAt(
+    const double* __restrict__ below, const double* __restrict__ center,
+    const double* __restrict__ above, const int muX, const int muY,
+    const size_t baseX, const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {
+    // muX/muY describe a one-cell-halo tile.  Clamp the coordinate first,
+    // then locate that real cell in the two-cell-halo concentration tile.
+    // This distinction is required at physical boundaries: mu(-1) is mu(0),
+    // not the potential of an artificial ghost cell.
+    const long long rawX = static_cast<long long>(baseX) + muX - 1;
+    const long long rawY = static_cast<long long>(baseY) + muY - 1;
+    const size_t x = clampCoordinate(rawX, nx);
+    const size_t y = clampCoordinate(rawY, ny);
+    const int sharedX = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(x) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {
+            const int haloX = muX + kBlockX;
+            potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + haloX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+                below, center, above, haloX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
         }
     }
 }

+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}

+template <bool ComputePotential>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 4) void streamedStencil(
+    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
+    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
+    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double tile[kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long z = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const size_t rawX = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+    const size_t rawY = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+    const size_t x = rawX < nx ? rawX : nx - 1;
+    const size_t y = rawY < ny ? rawY : ny - 1;
+
+    size_t centerIndex = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    double below = stencilInput[(z == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<size_t>(z) - 1) *
+                                    planeStride +
+                                y * nx + x];
+    double center = stencilInput[centerIndex];
+    double above = stencilInput[(static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1 < nz
+                                     ? static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1
+                                     : static_cast<size_t>(z)) *
+                                    planeStride +
+                                y * nx + x];
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (z >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1] = center;
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            const size_t haloX = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
+            tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx +
+                             haloX];
+        } else if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+            const size_t haloX = x + 1 < nx ? x + 1 : x;
+            tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX + kBlockX + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx +
+                             haloX];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            const size_t haloY = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
+            tile[tx + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride +
+                             haloY * nx + x];
+        } else if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+            const size_t haloY = y + 1 < ny ? y + 1 : y;
+            tile[(kBlockY + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride +
+                             haloY * nx + x];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (rawX < nx && rawY < ny) {
+            const int sharedIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double cxx = tile[sharedIndex + 1] +
+                               tile[sharedIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+            const double cyy = tile[sharedIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                               tile[sharedIndex - kMuTileX] - 2.0 * center;
+            const double czz = above + below - 2.0 * center;
+            const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+            if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
+                output[centerIndex] = center * center * center - center -
+                                      0.5 * laplacian;
+            } else {
+                output[centerIndex] =
+                    oldConcentration[centerIndex] + 0.01 * laplacian;
             }
         }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock || z + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        ++z;
+        centerIndex += planeStride;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        const size_t nextZ = static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1 < nz
+                                 ? static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1
+                                 : static_cast<size_t>(z);
+        above = stencilInput[nextZ * planeStride + y * nx + x];
     }
 }

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,

template <bool ComputePotential>
__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock) void directStencil(
    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
    const size_t z = blockIdx.z;
    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) {
        return;
    }
    const size_t xMinus = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
    const size_t xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? x : x + 1;
    const size_t yMinus = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
    const size_t yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? y : y + 1;
    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
    const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
    const double value = stencilInput[index];
    const double cxx = stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xPlus] +
                       stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xMinus] -
                       2.0 * value;
    const double cyy = stencilInput[z * planeStride + yPlus * nx + x] +
                       stencilInput[z * planeStride + yMinus * nx + x] -
                       2.0 * value;
    const double czz = stencilInput[zPlus * planeStride + y * nx + x] +
                       stencilInput[zMinus * planeStride + y * nx + x] -
                       2.0 * value;
    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
    if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
        output[index] = value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
    } else {
        output[index] = oldConcentration[index] + 0.01 * laplacian;
    }
}

void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& concentration) {
    const size_t volume = concentration.size();
    for (size_t linearId = 0; linearId < volume; ++linearId) {
        const double pseudo =
            ((linearId + 1) * size_t{1299709} % volume) /
            static_cast<double>(volume);
        concentration[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& concentration) {
    for (const double value : concentration) {
        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationValue(

+__device__ __forceinline__ void loadConcentrationPlane(

+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,

+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseX)) + 2;
+    const int sharedY = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(y) -
+                                         static_cast<long long>(baseY)) + 2;
+    const int xMinus = x == 0 ? sharedX : sharedX - 1;
+    const int xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? sharedX : sharedX + 1;
+    const int yMinus = y == 0 ? sharedY : sharedY - 1;
+    const int yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? sharedY : sharedY + 1;
+    const int centerIndex = sharedY * kCTileX + sharedX;
+    const double value = center[centerIndex];
+
+    // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in this benchmark.  Retaining the original
+    // per-axis association keeps the discretization identical.
+    const double cxx = center[sharedY * kCTileX + xPlus] +
+                       center[sharedY * kCTileX + xMinus] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double cyy = center[yPlus * kCTileX + sharedX] +
+                       center[yMinus * kCTileX + sharedX] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double czz = above[centerIndex] + below[centerIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+    const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+
+    // With e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9, the original bulk-energy
+    // derivative reduces algebraically to c^3-c.
+    return value * value * value - value - 0.5 * laplacian;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+    const double* __restrict__ concentrationTiles,
+    double* __restrict__ potentialTile, const long long rawPotentialZ,
+    const long long outputZ, const int concentrationHead, const size_t baseX,
+    const size_t baseY, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t z = clampCoordinate(rawPotentialZ, nz);
+    const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+    const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+    const long long windowStart = outputZ - 2;
+    const int belowOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zMinus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const int centerOffset =
+        static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(z) - windowStart);
+    const int aboveOffset = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(zPlus) -
+                                             windowStart);
+    const double* const below =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, belowOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const center =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, centerOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+    const double* const above =
+        concentrationTiles +
+        ringSlot(concentrationHead, aboveOffset, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+
+    for (int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y); muY < kMuTileY;
+         muY += kBlockY) {
+        const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + muX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+            below, center, above, muX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
+        if (muX < kMuTileX - kBlockX) {
+            const int haloX = muX + kBlockX;
+            potentialTile[muY * kMuTileX + haloX] = chemicalPotentialAt(
+                below, center, above, haloX, muY, baseX, baseY, nx, ny);
         }
     }
 }

+// Fuse chemical-potential construction with the Cahn-Hilliard update.  Five
+// concentration planes and three potential planes form rolling shared-memory
+// windows as each block advances through its Z segment.  Every interior plane
+// after startup requires one coalesced global load and one coalesced store;
+// the full chemical-potential volume never touches global memory.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 3) void cahnHilliardStep(
+    double* __restrict__ next, const double* __restrict__ current,
+    const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+    const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double concentrationTiles[5 * kCPlaneSize];
+    __shared__ double potentialTiles[3 * kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long outputZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 5; ++plane) {
+        loadConcentrationPlane(current,
+                               concentrationTiles + plane * kCPlaneSize,
+                               outputZ + plane - 2, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz,
+                               planeStride);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int plane = 0; plane < 3; ++plane) {
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles, potentialTiles + plane * kMuPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + plane - 1, outputZ, 0, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int concentrationHead = 0;
+    int potentialHead = 0;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (outputZ >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+        const size_t x = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+        const size_t y = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+
+        if (x < nx && y < ny) {
+            const double* const potentialBelow =
+                potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialCenter =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 1, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const double* const potentialAbove =
+                potentialTiles + ringSlot(potentialHead, 2, 3) * kMuPlaneSize;
+            const int muIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double value = potentialCenter[muIndex];
+            const double muxx = potentialCenter[muIndex + 1] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - 1] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double muyy = potentialCenter[muIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                                 potentialCenter[muIndex - kMuTileX] -
+                                 2.0 * value;
+            const double muzz = potentialAbove[muIndex] +
+                                 potentialBelow[muIndex] - 2.0 * value;
+            const double laplacian = muxx + muyy + muzz;
+            const double* const concentrationCenter =
+                concentrationTiles +
+                ringSlot(concentrationHead, 2, 5) * kCPlaneSize;
+            const double oldValue =
+                concentrationCenter[(ty + 2) * kCTileX + tx + 2];
+            const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(outputZ) * planeStride +
+                                 y * nx + x;
+            next[index] = oldValue + 0.01 * laplacian;
+        }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock ||
+            outputZ + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // No thread may replace a shared plane until all consumers finish.
+        __syncthreads();
+        loadConcentrationPlane(
+            current, concentrationTiles + concentrationHead * kCPlaneSize,
+            outputZ + 3, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz, planeStride);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int newConcentrationHead =
+            concentrationHead == 4 ? 0 : concentrationHead + 1;
+        computeChemicalPotentialPlane(
+            concentrationTiles,
+            potentialTiles + potentialHead * kMuPlaneSize, outputZ + 2,
+            outputZ + 1, newConcentrationHead, baseX, baseY, nx, ny, nz);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        concentrationHead = newConcentrationHead;
+        potentialHead = potentialHead == 2 ? 0 : potentialHead + 1;
+        ++outputZ;
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool ComputePotential>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 4) void streamedStencil(
+    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
+    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
+    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ double tile[kMuPlaneSize];
+
+    const size_t baseX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t baseY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY;
+    long long z = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kZPerBlock;
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const size_t rawX = baseX + static_cast<size_t>(tx);
+    const size_t rawY = baseY + static_cast<size_t>(ty);
+    const size_t x = rawX < nx ? rawX : nx - 1;
+    const size_t y = rawY < ny ? rawY : ny - 1;
+
+    size_t centerIndex = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+    double below = stencilInput[(z == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<size_t>(z) - 1) *
+                                    planeStride +
+                                y * nx + x];
+    double center = stencilInput[centerIndex];
+    double above = stencilInput[(static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1 < nz
+                                     ? static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1
+                                     : static_cast<size_t>(z)) *
+                                    planeStride +
+                                y * nx + x];
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int step = 0; step < kZPerBlock; ++step) {
+        if (z >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1] = center;
+        if (tx == 0) {
+            const size_t haloX = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
+            tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx +
+                             haloX];
+        } else if (tx == kBlockX - 1) {
+            const size_t haloX = x + 1 < nx ? x + 1 : x;
+            tile[(ty + 1) * kMuTileX + kBlockX + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride + y * nx +
+                             haloX];
+        }
+        if (ty == 0) {
+            const size_t haloY = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
+            tile[tx + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride +
+                             haloY * nx + x];
+        } else if (ty == kBlockY - 1) {
+            const size_t haloY = y + 1 < ny ? y + 1 : y;
+            tile[(kBlockY + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1] =
+                stencilInput[static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride +
+                             haloY * nx + x];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (rawX < nx && rawY < ny) {
+            const int sharedIndex = (ty + 1) * kMuTileX + tx + 1;
+            const double cxx = tile[sharedIndex + 1] +
+                               tile[sharedIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+            const double cyy = tile[sharedIndex + kMuTileX] +
+                               tile[sharedIndex - kMuTileX] - 2.0 * center;
+            const double czz = above + below - 2.0 * center;
+            const double laplacian = cxx + cyy + czz;
+            if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
+                output[centerIndex] = center * center * center - center -
+                                      0.5 * laplacian;
+            } else {
+                output[centerIndex] =
+                    oldConcentration[centerIndex] + 0.01 * laplacian;
             }
         }
+
+        if (step + 1 == kZPerBlock || z + 1 >= static_cast<long long>(nz)) {
+            break;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        ++z;
+        centerIndex += planeStride;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+        const size_t nextZ = static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1 < nz
+                                 ? static_cast<size_t>(z) + 1
+                                 : static_cast<size_t>(z);
+        above = stencilInput[nextZ * planeStride + y * nx + x];
     }
 }

codex
Profiling showed the fused shared-memory kernel was compute-bound because halo potentials had to be recomputed. A cache-friendly two-kernel CUDA formulation is substantially faster on this stencil: about 8.9 GCellUpdates/s for the default case and 10.6 GCellUpdates/s on larger grids, versus 3.4–5.0 GCellUpdates/s for the fused variant. I’m retaining the faster formulation and removing the experimental path; its X-major warp layout makes every neighbor stream coalesced, while the GPU caches supply stencil reuse.

+// Both phases are the same seven-point stencil.  Specializing the bulk term
+// at compile time keeps the two kernels small (28 registers on sm_86) and
+// avoids runtime branches.  The chemical-potential field remains resident on
+// the GPU and is immediately consumed by the update kernel.
+template <bool ComputePotential>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock) void stencilKernel(
+    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
+    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
+    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
+    // Grid-stride loops are normally single-iteration.  They also allow very
+    // elongated domains to exceed CUDA's per-dimension grid limits without a
+    // different kernel or a serial CPU fallback.
+    for (size_t z = blockIdx.z; z < nz; z += gridDim.z) {
+        for (size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+             y < ny; y += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.y) * kBlockY) {
+            for (size_t x =
+                     static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+                 x < nx; x += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX) {
+                const size_t xMinus = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
+                const size_t xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? x : x + 1;
+                const size_t yMinus = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
+                const size_t yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? y : y + 1;
+                const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+                const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+                const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                const double value = stencilInput[index];
+
+                // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in the original benchmark.  Keep the
+                // same per-axis association and clamped boundary conditions.
+                const double xx =
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xPlus] +
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xMinus] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double yy =
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + yPlus * nx + x] +
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + yMinus * nx + x] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double zz =
+                    stencilInput[zPlus * planeStride + y * nx + x] +
+                    stencilInput[zMinus * planeStride + y * nx + x] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double laplacian = xx + yy + zz;
+
+                if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
+                    // e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9 reduce the original
+                    // bulk-energy derivative algebraically to c^3-c.
+                    output[index] = value * value * value - value -
+                                    0.5 * laplacian;
+                } else {
+                    // D=1 and dt=0.01.
+                    output[index] = oldConcentration[index] +
+                                    0.01 * laplacian;
+                }
             }
         }
     }
 }

-void cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,

+// Both phases are the same seven-point stencil.  Specializing the bulk term
+// at compile time keeps the two kernels small (28 registers on sm_86) and
+// avoids runtime branches.  The chemical-potential field remains resident on
+// the GPU and is immediately consumed by the update kernel.
+template <bool ComputePotential>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock) void stencilKernel(
+    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
+    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
+    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
+    // Grid-stride loops are normally single-iteration.  They also allow very
+    // elongated domains to exceed CUDA's per-dimension grid limits without a
+    // different kernel or a serial CPU fallback.
+    for (size_t z = blockIdx.z; z < nz; z += gridDim.z) {
+        for (size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+             y < ny; y += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.y) * kBlockY) {
+            for (size_t x =
+                     static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+                 x < nx; x += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX) {
+                const size_t xMinus = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
+                const size_t xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? x : x + 1;
+                const size_t yMinus = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
+                const size_t yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? y : y + 1;
+                const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+                const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+                const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                const double value = stencilInput[index];
+
+                // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in the original benchmark.  Keep the
+                // same per-axis association and clamped boundary conditions.
+                const double xx =
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xPlus] +
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xMinus] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double yy =
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + yPlus * nx + x] +
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + yMinus * nx + x] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double zz =
+                    stencilInput[zPlus * planeStride + y * nx + x] +
+                    stencilInput[zMinus * planeStride + y * nx + x] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double laplacian = xx + yy + zz;
+
+                if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
+                    // e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9 reduce the original
+                    // bulk-energy derivative algebraically to c^3-c.
+                    output[index] = value * value * value - value -
+                                    0.5 * laplacian;
+                } else {
+                    // D=1 and dt=0.01.
+                    output[index] = oldConcentration[index] +
+                                    0.01 * laplacian;
+                }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                   size_t& planeStride, size_t& volume) {
+    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    planeStride = nx * ny;
+    if (planeStride > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    volume = planeStride * nz;
+    return volume <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double);

+// Both phases are the same seven-point stencil.  Specializing the bulk term
+// at compile time keeps the two kernels small (28 registers on sm_86) and
+// avoids runtime branches.  The chemical-potential field remains resident on
+// the GPU and is immediately consumed by the update kernel.
+template <bool ComputePotential>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock) void stencilKernel(
+    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
+    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
+    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
+    // Grid-stride loops are normally single-iteration.  They also allow very
+    // elongated domains to exceed CUDA's per-dimension grid limits without a
+    // different kernel or a serial CPU fallback.
+    for (size_t z = blockIdx.z; z < nz; z += gridDim.z) {
+        for (size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+             y < ny; y += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.y) * kBlockY) {
+            for (size_t x =
+                     static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+                 x < nx; x += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX) {
+                const size_t xMinus = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
+                const size_t xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? x : x + 1;
+                const size_t yMinus = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
+                const size_t yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? y : y + 1;
+                const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+                const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+                const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                const double value = stencilInput[index];
+
+                // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in the original benchmark.  Keep the
+                // same per-axis association and clamped boundary conditions.
+                const double xx =
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xPlus] +
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xMinus] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double yy =
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + yPlus * nx + x] +
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + yMinus * nx + x] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double zz =
+                    stencilInput[zPlus * planeStride + y * nx + x] +
+                    stencilInput[zMinus * planeStride + y * nx + x] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double laplacian = xx + yy + zz;
+
+                if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
+                    // e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9 reduce the original
+                    // bulk-energy derivative algebraically to c^3-c.
+                    output[index] = value * value * value - value -
+                                    0.5 * laplacian;
+                } else {
+                    // D=1 and dt=0.01.
+                    output[index] = oldConcentration[index] +
+                                    0.01 * laplacian;
+                }
             }
         }
     }
 }

+bool checkedVolume(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                   size_t& planeStride, size_t& volume) {
+    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    planeStride = nx * ny;
+    if (planeStride > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    volume = planeStride * nz;
+    return volume <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double);
+}

+// Both phases are the same seven-point stencil.  Specializing the bulk term
+// at compile time keeps the two kernels small (28 registers on sm_86) and
+// avoids runtime branches.  The chemical-potential field remains resident on
+// the GPU and is immediately consumed by the update kernel.
+template <bool ComputePotential>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock) void stencilKernel(
+    double* __restrict__ output, const double* __restrict__ stencilInput,
+    const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration, const size_t nx,
+    const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t planeStride) {
+    // Grid-stride loops are normally single-iteration.  They also allow very
+    // elongated domains to exceed CUDA's per-dimension grid limits without a
+    // different kernel or a serial CPU fallback.
+    for (size_t z = blockIdx.z; z < nz; z += gridDim.z) {
+        for (size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+             y < ny; y += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.y) * kBlockY) {
+            for (size_t x =
+                     static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+                 x < nx; x += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * kBlockX) {
+                const size_t xMinus = x == 0 ? x : x - 1;
+                const size_t xPlus = x + 1 == nx ? x : x + 1;
+                const size_t yMinus = y == 0 ? y : y - 1;
+                const size_t yPlus = y + 1 == ny ? y : y + 1;
+                const size_t zMinus = z == 0 ? z : z - 1;
+                const size_t zPlus = z + 1 == nz ? z : z + 1;
+                const size_t index = z * planeStride + y * nx + x;
+                const double value = stencilInput[index];
+
+                // dx == dy == dz == 1.0 in the original benchmark.  Keep the
+                // same per-axis association and clamped boundary conditions.
+                const double xx =
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xPlus] +
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + y * nx + xMinus] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double yy =
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + yPlus * nx + x] +
+                    stencilInput[z * planeStride + yMinus * nx + x] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double zz =
+                    stencilInput[zPlus * planeStride + y * nx + x] +
+                    stencilInput[zMinus * planeStride + y * nx + x] -
+                    2.0 * value;
+                const double laplacian = xx + yy + zz;
+
+                if constexpr (ComputePotential) {
+                    // e_AA=e_BB=-2/9 and e_AB=2/9 reduce the original
+                    // bulk-energy derivative algebraically to c^3-c.
+                    output[index] = value * value * value - value -
+                                    0.5 * laplacian;
+                } else {
+                    // D=1 and dt=0.01.
+                    output[index] = oldConcentration[index] +
+                                    0.01 * laplacian;
+                }
             }
         }
     }
